mapper.select: SELECT id,game_name,order_time,money,games_status FROM games WHERE username IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{userName}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize};

SELECT g.id,g.game_name,l.leaseorder_status,l.create_time,l.leaseorder_money,g.games_status,l.end_time FROM leaseorder l JOIN games g ON l.games_id = g.id WHERE l.users_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{userName}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{page},#{pageSize};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM games WHERE username IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{userName});
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leaseorder WHERE users_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = #{userName});
SELECT gameall_class FROM gameall WHERE gameall_name = #{gameName};
mapper.update: UPDATE gameall SET authorization = authorization + 1 WHERE gameall_name = #{gameName};
UPDATE games SET games_status = #{gameStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE gameall SET known = known + 1 WHERE gameall_name = #{gameName};
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(l.leaseorder_money) from rentingorder as r INNER JOIN leaseorder as l on r.games_id = l.games_id WHERE l.leaseorder_status = 1 and r.users_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) from rentingorder as r INNER JOIN leaseorder as l on r.games_id = l.games_id WHERE l.leaseorder_status = 1 and r.users_id = #{userId}
SELECT SUM(l.leaseorder_money) from leaseorder as l WHERE l.leaseorder_status = 1 and l.users_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) from leaseorder as l WHERE l.leaseorder_status = 1 and l.users_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE games SET games_status = 1 WHERE id = #{orderId} and username = #{UserID}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM games WHERE id = #{orderId} and username = #{UserID} and games_status = #{status}
